scope: Actual authenticated HTTP with an inert owned worker held live after interrupt until explicit test release.
Concurrent duplicate requests publish one original acknowledgement and one replay, with one interrupt. Stale/foreign commands do not signal.
Current pin version survives replay and worker exit; original acknowledgement stays cancelling while current state becomes cancelled or completed. Old replay cannot affect a newer queued attempt.
limits: No native execution or registered production adapters. Running-worker browser qualification remains open.
Non-null accepted-reference preservation is covered separately by the retained service suite, not the new HTTP cases.
No frontend or packaged-browser rerun for test-only change.
